name: Alex Padilla
office: City of Inglewood, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Alex Padilla has served on the Inglewood City Council since 2013. He spent 30 years with the Santa Monica Police Department, retiring as a captain. He later investigated police use of force for the LAPD inspector general. He chaired the city's Citizen Police Oversight Commission.

sentences.text: Alex Padilla has served on the Inglewood City Council since 2013.
He spent 30 years with the Santa Monica Police Department, retiring as a captain.
He later investigated police use of force for the LAPD inspector general.
He chaired the city's Citizen Police Oversight Commission.

items.text: His campaign says he has repaired streets and sidewalks. He voted to use eminent domain for the Inglewood Transit Connector in February 2026 and increase water and sewer rates in December 2025. He voted to rezone 68 acres for multifamily housing in November 2025. He also voted for a $6.3 million police technology contract with Axon in June 2026. He has said federal immigration raids tear families apart.
